items.title: Nvidia halts sales to SE Asia, SpaceX surges on Musk's share promise
items.summary: Nvidia has halted sales to Southeast Asia following the U.S. government's decision to tighten restrictions on China. SpaceX shares are popping after Elon Musk promised two shares of the company to every child in America with an active Trump Account. Julie Hyman and Jake Conley are joined by Washington Crossing Advisors Senior Portfolio Manager Chad Morganlander to discuss.
